start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:move-a-dated-plan with store {\"where\": \"postgresql database example_me on my own computer\", \"language\": \"SQL (PostgreSQL)\", \"credential_name\": \"example-me-postgres-connection\"} and plan {\"collection_id\": \"launch\", \"strategy\": \"shift\", \"lock\": \"started\", \"end\": \"2026-11-27\", \"today\": \"2026-11-10\", \"dry_run\": true}."
no_lists_because: It names no list of yours to write: it reads the dated tasks of the plan you name (a task list you already keep in your own store) and writes only their dates.
instructions: 1. Keep the store's login in your vault under a name you choose, and say where the store is and how it is spoken to.
2. Say "Run workflow:move-a-dated-plan" with store and the plan: the task list (or the task ids), the strategy, the lock, the end (or start) date, today, and dry_run.
3. The first run makes the store's own task rows once and proves them on the example plan: the prove step must give every expected date, or the run stops and says which.
4. Run it with dry_run true first: it shows the moved tasks and writes nothing. Run it again without dry_run to move them; the old dates are kept, so you can ask to undo the move.
